column1: # known-failing BACKLOG (#1452) — every entry is DEBT to fix, not a blessed exception.
# The list only SHRINKS: a test that passes comes OFF in the same commit (the checker
# enforces both directions). A stalled list is a regression. Endpoint: empty file, deleted.
# Format: <pytest-node-id>\t<tag>   tags: fixture | triage | flaky | regression:#NNNN
#   fixture      = test-infra rot (contamination victim, stale mock, env assumption)
#   regression:# = the PRODUCT broke — tracked by the referenced issue, never parked silently
#   triage       = not yet glanced — triaging it IS part of the burn-down
#   flaky        = oscillates run-to-run (tolerated both states); burn-down = DE-FLAKE, then retag
